What is Kuldevta Hawan and Why is it Important?
Each family lineage has a Kuldevta (family deity) who provides divine blessings, protection, and guidance .
If your Kuldevta’s energy (Tarang) is weak or disconnected , you may face several difficulties in life. The Kuldevta Hawan helps restore this energy and invites divine grace into your life.
When Kuldevta Blessings are Absent, It May Lead To:
❌ Financial Struggles – Money flow remains blocked.
❌ Delays in Marriage – Finding a suitable partner becomes difficult.
❌ Childbirth Issues – Struggles with conceiving or complications in pregnancy.
❌ Obstacles in Spiritual Growth – Third Eye Activation becomes difficult.
❌ Pitra Dosh Problems – Ancestral spirits may disturb your peace.
Kuldevta’s Blessings Help With:
✔ Financial Prosperity – Wealth and abundance start flowing into your life.
✔ Successful Marriage & Relationships – Finding the right life partner.
✔ Blessings for Parenthood – A smooth and blessed journey to having children.
✔ Spiritual Awakening – Strengthens your Third Eye Activation .
How Does the Kuldevta Hawan Work?

Our Kuldevta Hawan is conducted remotely via Zoom meetings , making it accessible worldwide. Through this sacred fire ritual , divine offerings ( Bhog ) are sent to your Kuldevta through the power of Ram Naam Hawan .
Step-by-Step Process:
1️⃣ Aura & Energy Check – Identify the level of Kuldevta Tarang in your aura.
1️⃣Online Sankalp (Intention Setting) – Your name and family lineage are included in the ritual.
2️⃣Ram Naam Hawan – Sacred offerings are made to your Kuldevta .
3️⃣Energy Transmission – The divine energy starts flowing towards you.
4️⃣Results in 2 Months 22 Days – After the Hawan, you can check your energy progress after 2 months and 22 days.
This time-tested process has helped many aspirants restore balance, attract divine blessings, and progress spiritually .
